title: Advanced Environment and Lighting Specialist Practical

domains.name: Light quantity distribution and dose analysis

criticalErrors: Makes a major control or lighting change from a clearly unverified or failed sensor without first resolving measurement quality.
Confuses PPFD, photoperiod, and DLI in a way that would materially misstate delivered light dose.
Recommends a room-wide change while ignoring supplied evidence that the deviation is localized.
Falsifies or discards contradictory measurement evidence to support a preferred conclusion.
